description: 원자력안전위원회_국내 원자력발전소 현황 [nuclear facilities and electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 원자력안전위원회. 2025년 6월 기준 국내 원자력발전소의 현황 데이터입니다. - 현황 데이터는 원자력발전소의 명칭, 노형, 원자로공급사, 용량(MWe), 건설허가일, 착공일(기초굴착일), 운영 허가일. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 원자력안전위원회. Its tags are 국내, 원자력발전소, 현황데이터, 원자력발전소 명칭, 건설 및 운영허가일. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
